path: ServerScriptService/LeaderboardService.server.luau
purpose: Feature: Leaderboard: leaderstats show Cash and Rebirths for every player, and a big in-world leaderboard board stands in the central plaza (SurfaceGui on a themed stand, title 'TOP TYCOONS') listing the top 10 players in the server by lifetime earnings (a server-tracked TotalEarned value), refreshed every 5 seconds, each row showing rank, name, rebirths and formatted earnings (1.2K, 3.4M). Format all big numbers in the HUD the same way through a shared ReplicatedStorage NumberFormat module. Bump counter leaderboard_refresh. -- Self-booting Script, so Game.server needs no edit. (1) For each player (PlayerAdded plus a Players:GetPlayers() loop at startup) it waits up to about 10s for the 'leaderstats' folder and for the Cash and Rebirths values. If either value is still missing after the timeout, it creates the missing IntValue with FindFirstChild first, so it never duplicates the Tycoon or RebirthService ones. (2) It tracks lifetime earnings in a server-only table keyed by player and mirrors the total to player:SetAttribute('TotalEarned', n). The attribute is not placed in leaderstats. It connects Cash.Changed and adds only positive deltas, so spending and rebirth resets never reduce the total. (3) It builds the board in the central plaza, using the plaza centre from ReplicatedStorage/PlotThemes. It waits for the plaza to exist and offsets the stand so it sits off the spawn path and clear of the fountain and the claim gates. The stand is a themed anchored part (frame, back panel, base, theme colours, not default grey) with a SurfaceGui (Face toward the plaza centre) titled 'TOP TYCOONS'. Below the title are 10 row Frames, each with TextLabels for rank, name, rebirths ('R<n>') and earnings. The earnings text uses require(ReplicatedStorage.NumberFormat).short. Empty rows show '-'. (4) A loop using task.spawn and task.wait(5) does a refresh immediately and then every 5 seconds. A refresh sorts players by TotalEarned descending, with name as the tiebreak. It writes the top 10 rows and calls require(ReplicatedStorage.ForgeTelemetry).count('leaderboard_refresh', 1) exactly once per refresh. This is the only place that counter is bumped. It cleans up the player's table entry on PlayerRemoving. No remotes are needed. Bump ForgeTelemetry counters: leaderboard_refresh.
depends: ReplicatedStorage/NumberFormat.luau, ReplicatedStorage/PlotThemes.luau, ReplicatedStorage/ForgeTelemetry.luau, ReplicatedStorage/UiTheme.luau

```luau
--!strict
-- NumberFormat: pure shared helpers for compact number display (no services, no side effects).

local NumberFormat = {}

-- Ascending list of units.
local UNITS: { { any } } = {
	{ 1e3, "K" },
	{ 1e6, "M" },
	{ 1e9, "B" },
	{ 1e12, "T" },
}

local function roundTenth(x: number): number
	return math.floor(x * 10 + 0.5) / 10
end

local function trim(v: number): string
	local s = string.format("%.1f", v)
	s = s:gsub("%.0$", "")
	return s
end

-- 999 -> "999", 1234 -> "1.2K", 999950 -> "1M", 3400000 -> "3.4M"
function NumberFormat.short(n: any): string
	if type(n) ~= "number" or n ~= n then
		return "0"
	end
	local num: number = n
	if num == math.huge then
		return "∞"
	elseif num == -math.huge then
		return "-∞"
	end
	local neg = num < 0
	local a = math.abs(num)
	local sign = if neg then "-" else ""

	if a < 1000 then
		local r = math.floor(a + 0.5)
		if r < 1000 then
			if r == 0 then
				return "0"
			end
			return sign .. tostring(r)
		end
		a = 1000 -- 999.5+ rounds up into the K range
	end

	local idx = 1
	for i = 1, #UNITS do
		if a >= (UNITS[i][1] :: number) then
			idx = i
		end
	end

	local v = roundTenth(a / (UNITS[idx][1] :: number))
	if v >= 1000 and idx < #UNITS then
		idx += 1
		v = roundTenth(a / (UNITS[idx][1] :: number))
	end
	return sign .. trim(v) .. (UNITS[idx][2] :: string)
end

-- 1234567 -> "1,234,567"
function NumberFormat.withCommas(n: any): string
	if type(n) ~= "number" or n ~= n or n == math.huge or n == -math.huge then
		return "0"
	end
	local num: number = n
	local neg = num < 0
	local s = string.format("%.0f", math.abs(num))
	local out = s
	while true do
		local replaced, count = out:gsub("^(%d+)(%d%d%d)", "%1,%2")
		out = replaced
		if count == 0 then
			break
		end
	end
	if out == "0" then
		return "0"
	end
	return (if neg then "-" else "") .. out
end

return NumberFormat
```

### ReplicatedStorage/ForgeTelemetry.luau
```luau
--!strict
-- ForgeTelemetry: tiny counter API for generated games. ForgeProbe reports these counters.
--
--   local ForgeTelemetry = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").ForgeTelemetry)
--   ForgeTelemetry.count("coins_collected")      -- +1
--   ForgeTelemetry.count("damage_dealt", 25)     -- +25
--   ForgeTelemetry.get()                          -- { coins_collected = 1, damage_dealt = 25 }
--
-- Counters live as number attributes on ServerStorage.ForgeCounters (a Folder), so every VM in the
-- server (game scripts, ForgeProbe, execute_luau) sees the same values. Server only: on the client
-- count() is a no-op and get() returns {}.

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local FOLDER_NAME = "ForgeCounters"

local ForgeTelemetry = {}

local function folder(): Instance?
	if not RunService:IsServer() then
		return nil
	end
	local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")
	local f = ServerStorage:FindFirstChild(FOLDER_NAME)
	if not f then
		f = Instance.new("Folder")
		f.Name = FOLDER_NAME
		f.Parent = ServerStorage
	end
	return f
end

-- Attribute names: letters, digits and underscores, max 100 chars, may not start with "RBX".
local function key(name: string): string
	local k = string.gsub(tostring(name), "[^%w_]", "_")
	if k == "" then
		k = "_"
	end
	if string.sub(k, 1, 3) == "RBX" then
		k = "_" .. k
	end
	return string.sub(k, 1, 100)
end

function ForgeTelemetry.count(name: string, n: number?)
	local f = folder()
	if not f then
		return
	end
	local ok = pcall(function()
		local k = key(name)
		local cur = f:GetAttribute(k)
		local add = tonumber(n) or 1
		f:SetAttribute(k, (if type(cur) == "number" then cur else 0) + add)
	end)
	if not ok then
		-- telemetry must never break the game
		return
	end
end

function ForgeTelemetry.get(): { [string]: number }
	local out: { [string]: number } = {}
	if not RunService:IsServer() then
		return out
	end
	local f = game:GetService("ServerStorage"):FindFirstChild(FOLDER_NAME)
	if not f then
		return out
	end
	for k, v in f:GetAttributes() do
		if type(v) == "number" then
			out[k] = v
		end
	end
	return out
end

return ForgeTelemetry
```

## Lessons from past builds
# Lessons
## Design
- Tune early progression so a playtest of roughly 15 seconds can reach the first purchase or milestone. Use a fast starting income or a cheap first upgrade (a few seconds of income). Slow openings leave the buy loop untested and feel dull.
- Give per-event feedback for every economy action: a "+N" popup on collect, plus HUD hints for upgrade cost, affordability or progress. Without it, numbers going up feels weak between purchases.
- Place trigger pads (buy pads, claim gates, etc.) off the spawn path so walking from spawn never fires them accidentally.
- Make moving cubes or other spawned items non-colliding with players (CanCollide = false, or a collision group) and cap their count per area. Otherwise they jitter, stick or knock players around.

## Luau and Roblox APIs
- The base place is empty: build the map from code (Instance.new Parts, Anchored = true, parented to Workspace).
- Get services with game:GetService("Players") etc.; use task.wait / task.spawn / task.delay, never wait / spawn / delay.
- Players.PlayerAdded can fire before your script connects in a playtest: also loop over Players:GetPlayers() once at startup.
- Wait for characters with player.CharacterAdded (and player.Character if already present); use WaitForChild with a timeout across the client/server boundary.
- ModuleScripts must return exactly one value (usually a table); require them by path, e.g. require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Config")).
- Create RemoteEvents on the server in one place; clients only WaitForChild them and handle nil after the timeout.
- Bump counters for key gameplay events with require(ReplicatedStorage.ForgeTelemetry).count("name", 1) (server only) so playtests can verify the core loop. Include counters for purchases and other branches that need verification.
- Count each telemetry counter in exactly one place (the module that owns the event). Duplicate count calls push once-only counters past their expected value.
- Touched fires many times per touch: debounce per player (a per-player cooldown or a one-time purchased flag) and check and deduct cost in the same step to prevent double-buys or double-spends.
- Define the data shape that a builder module returns (field names such as origin, gate, spawn) once, and have consumers use those exact fields. Do not add `a or b` fallbacks for guessed names.

## Fixing and debugging
- A "sync" StudioError about not being able to serve a path is an infrastructure or environment failure, not a code bug. Do not change game code in response. Retry the step.
- If the critic says a code path was never exercised in the playtest, fix the pacing or setup so the path actually runs (e.g. cheaper first purchase) instead of only adding more code.
- When the spec changes the flow (e.g. from auto-assign to claim), rewrite the entry script (Game.server) to require and wire the new modules, and delete the old flow's logic (slots, teleport on join). Updating only the new modules leaves the old behaviour running.
- After a redesign, check that every module is required by the entry script and that its init function is called. Unwired modules never run, and their counters never fire.

```luau
--!strict
-- LeaderboardService: lifetime-earnings tracking, leaderstats guarantees and the in-world TOP TYCOONS board.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local NumberFormat = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("NumberFormat"))
local PlotThemes = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("PlotThemes"))
local ForgeTelemetry = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("ForgeTelemetry"))
local UiTheme = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("UiTheme"))

local ROWS = 10
local REFRESH = 5
local WAIT_TIMEOUT = 10

local totals: { [Player]: number } = {}
local conns: { [Player]: RBXScriptConnection } = {}

local function ensureValue(folder: Instance, name: string): IntValue
	local v = folder:FindFirstChild(name)
	if v and v:IsA("IntValue") then
		return v
	end
	local nv = Instance.new("IntValue")
	nv.Name = name
	nv.Value = 0
	nv.Parent = folder
	return nv
end

local function setupPlayer(player: Player)
	if totals[player] ~= nil then
		return
	end
	totals[player] = 0
	player:SetAttribute("TotalEarned", 0)

	local stats = player:WaitForChild("leaderstats", WAIT_TIMEOUT)
	if player.Parent == nil then
		return
	end
	if not stats then
		local f = Instance.new("Folder")
		f.Name = "leaderstats"
		f.Parent = player
		stats = f
	end
	local s = stats :: Instance
	s:WaitForChild("Cash", WAIT_TIMEOUT)
	s:WaitForChild("Rebirths", WAIT_TIMEOUT)
	if player.Parent == nil then
		return
	end
	local cash = ensureValue(s, "Cash")
	ensureValue(s, "Rebirths")

	local last = cash.Value
	conns[player] = cash.Changed:Connect(function(newValue)
		local delta = newValue - last
		last = newValue
		if delta > 0 and totals[player] ~= nil then
			totals[player] += delta
			player:SetAttribute("TotalEarned", totals[player])
		end
	end)
end

local function cleanupPlayer(player: Player)
	totals[player] = nil
	local c = conns[player]
	if c then
		c:Disconnect()
		conns[player] = nil
	end
end

-- Find the plaza centre from the shared PlotThemes module.
local function getPlazaCenter(): Vector3
	local plaza: any = (PlotThemes :: any).Plaza
	if typeof(plaza) == "Vector3" then
		return plaza
	elseif typeof(plaza) == "CFrame" then
		return plaza.Position
	elseif type(plaza) == "table" then
		for _, key in { "center", "Center", "centre", "position", "Position", "origin" } do
			local v = plaza[key]
			if typeof(v) == "Vector3" then
				return v
			elseif typeof(v) == "CFrame" then
				return v.Position
			end
		end
	end
	return Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
end

local function makePart(name: string, size: Vector3, cf: CFrame, color: Color3, material: Enum.Material, parent: Instance): Part
	local p = Instance.new("Part")
	p.Name = name
	p.Size = size
	p.CFrame = cf
	p.Anchored = true
	p.CanCollide = true
	p.Color = color
	p.Material = material
	p.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	p.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	p.Parent = parent
	return p
end

type Row = { rank: TextLabel, name: TextLabel, rebirths: TextLabel, earned: TextLabel }

local function buildBoard(): { Row }
	local deadline = os.clock() + WAIT_TIMEOUT
	while not Workspace:FindFirstChild("Plaza") and os.clock() < deadline do
		task.wait(0.5)
	end
	local center = getPlazaCenter()
	-- off the spawn path, clear of fountain (centre) and gate ring
	local pos = center + Vector3.new(20, 0, 14)
	local cf = CFrame.lookAt(pos, Vector3.new(center.X, pos.Y, center.Z))

	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = "LeaderboardStand"

	makePart("Base", Vector3.new(15, 1, 4), cf * CFrame.new(0, 0.5, 0), UiTheme.accent, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, model)
	makePart("PostL", Vector3.new(1, 3, 1), cf * CFrame.new(-6.5, 2.5, 0.4), UiTheme.info, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, model)
	makePart("PostR", Vector3.new(1, 3, 1), cf * CFrame.new(6.5, 2.5, 0.4), UiTheme.info, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, model)
	makePart("Frame", Vector3.new(15, 17, 0.6), cf * CFrame.new(0, 10, 0.3), UiTheme.accent, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, model)
	local panel = makePart("BackPanel", Vector3.new(14, 16, 0.4), cf * CFrame.new(0, 10, -0.1), UiTheme.ink, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, model)

	local gui = Instance.new("SurfaceGui")
	gui.Name = "BoardGui"
	gui.Face = Enum.NormalId.Front
	gui.SizingMode = Enum.SurfaceGuiSizingMode.FixedSize
	gui.CanvasSize = Vector2.new(700, 800)
	gui.LightInfluence = 0
	gui.Parent = panel

	local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	title.Name = "Title"
	title.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.96, 0.1)
	title.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.02, 0.01)
	title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	title.Text = "TOP TYCOONS"
	title.TextScaled = true
	title.Font = UiTheme.headerFont
	title.TextColor3 = UiTheme.accent
	title.Parent = gui

	local rows: { Row } = {}
	for i = 1, ROWS do
		local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
		frame.Name = "Row" .. i
		frame.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.96, 0.077)
		frame.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.02, 0.125 + (i - 1) * 0.085)
		frame.BackgroundColor3 = UiTheme.cream
		frame.BackgroundTransparency = if i % 2 == 0 then 0.85 else 0.92
		frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
		frame.Parent = gui
		local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
		corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
		corner.Parent = frame

		local function label(n: string, x: number, w: number, align: Enum.TextXAlignment, color: Color3): TextLabel
			local l = Instance.new("TextLabel")
			l.Name = n
			l.Size = UDim2.fromScale(w, 0.8)
			l.Position = UDim2.fromScale(x, 0.1)
			l.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			l.Text = "-"
			l.TextScaled = true
			l.Font = UiTheme.font
			l.TextColor3 = color
			l.TextXAlignment = align
			l.Parent = frame
			return l
		end
		local rankColor = if i <= 3 then UiTheme.accent else UiTheme.cream
		rows[i] = {
			rank = label("Rank", 0.01, 0.1, Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, rankColor),
			name = label("Name", 0.13, 0.42, Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, UiTheme.cream),
			rebirths = label("Rebirths", 0.56, 0.14, Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, UiTheme.info),
			earned = label("Earned", 0.72, 0.26, Enum.TextXAlignment.Right, UiTheme.good),
		}
		rows[i].rank.Text = tostring(i)
	end

	model.Parent = Workspace
	return rows
end

local function refresh(rows: { Row })
	local list: { { player: Player, total: number } } = {}
	for player, total in totals do
		if player.Parent == Players then
			table.insert(list, { player = player, total = total })
		end
	end
	table.sort(list, function(a, b)
		if a.total ~= b.total then
			return a.total > b.total
		end
		return a.player.Name < b.player.Name
	end)
	for i = 1, ROWS do
		local row = rows[i]
		local entry = list[i]
		if entry then
			local stats = entry.player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
			local rb = stats and stats:FindFirstChild("Rebirths")
			local rebirths = if rb and rb:IsA("IntValue") then rb.Value else 0
			row.name.Text = entry.player.Name
			row.rebirths.Text = "R" .. tostring(rebirths)
			row.earned.Text = "$" .. NumberFormat.short(entry.total)
		else
			row.name.Text = "-"
			row.rebirths.Text = "-"
			row.earned.Text = "-"
		end
	end
	ForgeTelemetry.count("leaderboard_refresh", 1)
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
	task.spawn(setupPlayer, player)
end)
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(cleanupPlayer)
for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
	task.spawn(setupPlayer, player)
end

task.spawn(function()
	local rows = buildBoard()
	while true do
		local ok, err = pcall(refresh, rows)
		if not ok then
			warn("LeaderboardService refresh failed: " .. tostring(err))
		end
		task.wait(REFRESH)
	end
end)
```
